segment.description: 'laptop' = a GPU built into laptops (e.g. a GeForce RTX Laptop GPU), not the desktop card of the same name

series.description: product family, e.g. 'GeForce RTX 40', 'Instinct', 'Apple Silicon'; absent when the maker names no family other than the architecture generation, never a copy of `generation`

generation.description: architecture generation as the vendor names it, e.g. 'Ada Lovelace', 'CDNA 3', 'M4'; the text a consumer shows

architecture.description: FK → gpu-architecture/<slug>: the record of `generation`, when exactly one has that name; absent otherwise

compute_capability.description: NVIDIA only: the CUDA compute capability as NVIDIA lists it (CUDA GPUs page or the architecture whitepaper); absent when NVIDIA lists none

release_date.description: the maker's announced availability or launch date; the announcement date only when the maker gives nothing more exact than a month or quarter; absent when the maker states no date

signal_strength.description: how much AI-practitioner attention the product draws

summary.description: one-sentence description; its only home, the body does not repeat it

image.description: public path of the product photo, e.g. '/images/gpus/nvidia-h100-sxm.jpg'

compute_platform.description: the acceleration platform frameworks target on this product; framework-support records are keyed by it

specifications.description: every field but unit_kind is absent when the maker does not publish it

unit_kind.description: 'module' = several GPUs sold as one unit; memory, compute units and TDP then cover the whole module

memory_note.description: remark the source put beside the memory type

memory_kind.description: set only when CPU and GPU share the memory

memory_options_gb.description: unified memory only: every memory size of the computers the maker sells with the chip (for Apple: Macs), smallest first, from their tech-spec pages; memory_gb is the largest

note.description: the bracketed remark as written, when it says more than the bandwidth (per GPU, per link, die-to-die)
the original text, kept when it is composite or carries a foundry or generation remark

performance.description: the maker's peak figures, always dense (no structured sparsity) and for ONE GPU (one chip or accelerator for TPU and Gaudi), even when unit_kind is 'module'; a figure the maker gives only with sparsity is halved only when the maker states sparse is twice dense, and a figure the maker gives only per module is left out

fp32_tflops.description: FP32 peak, one GPU; the non-Tensor (vector) figure unless only a matrix figure is published

fp16_tflops.description: FP16 Tensor Core / matrix peak, dense, one GPU; where the maker lists FP16 and FP32 accumulate (GeForce whitepapers), the FP32-accumulate figure

bf16_tflops.description: BF16 Tensor Core / matrix peak, dense, one GPU; the FP32-accumulate figure where the maker lists both

tf32_tflops.description: TF32 Tensor Core / matrix peak, dense, one GPU

fp8_tflops.description: FP8 Tensor Core / matrix peak, dense, one GPU; where the maker lists FP16 and FP32 accumulate (GeForce whitepapers), the FP32-accumulate figure

int8_tops.description: INT8 Tensor Core / matrix peak in TOPS, dense, one GPU

basis.description: whether the Tensor or matrix figures assume structured sparsity, when the maker states it; figures are stored dense, so 'sparse' is not used for new records; absent when the maker does not say

performance_basis_note.description: what the figures assume (dense or sparse), when a source states it

ml_capabilities.description: every field but inference is absent when no maker page supports it

max_units.description: most GPUs or chips the technology joins, when the source states a count

market.description: agent-owned: prices change; unknown prices are absent

msrp_usd.description: the maker's own published launch price (suggested retail or 'starting at'); absent when the maker published none

msrp_source.description: the maker's press release, newsroom post or product page that states msrp_usd

msrp_announced.description: date of the announcement that states msrp_usd, as printed on msrp_source

instance_note.description: instance family or product as written, e.g. 'p5 instances'
